info.name: Fleet Application Management Service Fleet Apps Management Work Request API

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.
Empty only if the resource OCID query param is not specified.

params.name: workRequestId
params.description: The ID of the asynchronous work request.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only resources their lifecycleState matches the given OperationStatus.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeAccepted is descending.
